rules: Current child authority always wins over this cache.
A mismatch between this cache or CURRENT_SYSTEM historical verification and current child authority is a health finding requiring reconciliation.
Open findings block only affected hard prerequisites unless a verified common invariant requires broader blocking.

Capability-profile and minimum-contract observations are evolving compatibility floors; immutable business runtime releases and exact business cursors remain exact where their owner contract requires it.

cross_domain_learnings.finding: All four child 1.3 adoptions exposed at least one guard/test that treated an evolving capability profile or minimum common-behavior contract as an exact permanent value, creating false-negative CI on legitimate upgrades.
cross_domain_learnings.selected_rule: Use compatibility-floor semantics for fields whose contract is minimum/evolving; retain exact equality for immutable release identities, historical evidence identities and business cursors where exactness is intentional.

cross_domain_learnings.finding: A parent-side synthetic fresh-chat fixture passed while A-share production still used owner-native work-plane status/parent field names that the stricter parent validator would have rejected. The repair separates binding_status from child work-plane status and validates semantic authority aliases rather than forcing byte-identical child schemas.
cross_domain_learnings.selected_rule: Synthetic unit fixtures prove validator behavior only. Cross-repository promotion evidence must reread current child authority; child owner-native schemas may expose equivalent controller/status aliases when binding semantics remain explicit and fail-closed.
